Based on the official Imprint and Privacy Policy pages on **gnupg.org**, the operating legal entity behind GnuPG at this domain is **g10 Code GmbH** (also stylized as **g10code GmbH**).

### Evidence & Citation
The official Imprint page on **gnupg.org** states:
> *"GnuPG is an international community project run by volunteers and not a legal entity. **g10code GmbH** is the privately owned legal entity behind the GnuPG project. They employ all paid developers and re-invest the majority their profits into the development of GnuPG and related free software. [...] g10 Code GmbH. Bergstr. 3a. D-40699 Erkrath Germany."*
